In this video, we bring you the latest ground update from the *Bilaspur starting point of the Raipur–Dhanbad Economic Corridor (EC-07),* a major Greenfield infrastructure project aimed at improving connectivity across Central & Eastern India.
In our previous video, we covered the Urga–Pathalgaon section. This time, we have reached the Bilaspur end of the Urga–Bilaspur section, which is largely completed, although some important construction work is still pending at its starting location.
• What You'll See in This Video:*
• Ground update from the Bilaspur starting point of the corridor.
